Be it enacted by the General Assembly:

SECTION 1. Absentee voting; identification. Any voter casting a ballot in person shall present valid photographic identification issued by the Commonwealth or the federal government. A voter who does not present such identification shall not be issued a ballot. The provision that a voter may sign a statement, subject to felony penalties, that he is the named registered voter is repealed.

SECTION 2. Absentee voting expanded. Any qualified voter may vote by absentee ballot without providing an excuse or stating a reason in any election in which he is qualified to vote. The general registrar shall establish at least one drop box location in each county or city for the return of absentee ballots.

SECTION 3. Effective date. This act shall take effect on July 1.
